description: This source file defines an Android activity class `ShortcutPublisher`, responsible for creating, managing, and deleting app shortcuts, as well as handling related user interactions and system API calls. It includes logic for shortcut addition, update, deletion, and requesting pinned shortcuts, along with UI elements and list management.

classes.name: ShortcutPublisher
classes.description: Main activity managing shortcuts, user interactions, and UI for shortcut management within an Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI and shortcut manager.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the shortcut list when activity resumes.

methods.name: getAllShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves all manifest, dynamic, and pinned shortcuts related to this activity.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Sorts and updates the list adapter with current shortcuts.

methods.name: dumpCurrentShortcuts
methods.description: Logs current dynamic and pinned shortcuts for debugging.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message to the user.

methods.name: showThrottledToast
methods.description: Shows a message indicating API throttling.

methods.name: callApi
methods.description: Executes a shortcut API call with exception and throttling handling.

methods.name: addRandomIntents
methods.description: Adds random predefined intents and icons to shortcut builder for variety.

methods.name: onPublishPressed
methods.description: Creates and publishes new shortcuts dynamically.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable string.

methods.name: onAddPressed
methods.description: Adds a new dynamic shortcut with current timestamp.

methods.name: onUpdatePressed
methods.description: Updates existing shortcuts except immutable and specific shortcut.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Starts the activity associated with a shortcut.

methods.name: onShowNotificationPressed
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification with remote input.

methods.name: onRequestPinPressed
methods.description: Initiates a request to pin a new shortcut.

methods.name: requestPinShortcut
methods.description: Static method to request that the launcher pins a shortcut.
